description: Defines the BlockPickerOption class, a custom option component for a typeahead menu, extending the LexicalTypeaheadMenuPlugin's TypeaheadOption, tailored for use within a block picker plugin in a rich text editing context.

classes.name: BlockPickerOption
classes.description: A class representing an option in the block picker, including icon, keywords, shortcut, and selection behavior.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Constructs a BlockPickerOption instance with specified title and options, setting properties and binding the onSelect callback.
